title: Warm Brazilian Flatbread
description: A traditional Brazilian flatbread recipe with a crispy crust and warm interior, perfect for snacking.
instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, salt, and warm water. Mix until a dough forms.
2. Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
3. Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rest for 1 hour.
4. Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
5. Divide the dough into 4-6 equal pieces, depending on how large you want your flatbreads to be.
6. Roll out each piece of dough into a thin circle, about 6-7 inches in diameter.
7. Brush the tops of the flatbreads with vegetable oil and cook for 1-2 minutes on each side, until crispy and golden.
8. Serve warm, with optional warm milk for dipping.
